articles.title: Russia's 'Skyfall' Missile: A Flying Nuclear Reactor That Could Change Warfare Forever
articles.summary: Russia's nuclear-powered cruise missile, Skyfall, likely uses a direct-cycle reactor that spews radiation as it flies, MIT researchers say. The October test over the Arctic may mark the first nuclear-powered flight ever, raising fears of a dangerous new arms race.

articles.title: Black Oily Specks Rain Down on Moscow After Ukraine's Largest Drone Barrage Hits Refinery
articles.summary: In the largest Ukrainian drone attack since the war began, nearly 200 drones targeted Moscow, striking a refinery and causing black oily residue to fall on parts of the city. Russia intercepted almost 1,000 drones nationwide, but the attack brought the war home to ordinary Russians.

articles.title: Supreme Court Sides with Marijuana User, Rules Gun Ban Too Vague
articles.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that the federal ban on gun ownership by 'unlawful' drug users is unconstitutionally vague in the case of a Texas man who used marijuana every other day. The narrow decision doesn't legalize guns for all drug users but raises questions about Second Amendment limits.
